```sql
WITH LiteracyByRound AS (
    SELECT
        "District",
        "Survey Round",
        "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS Literacy
    FROM
        "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE
        "Survey Round" IN ('NFHS-4', 'NFHS-5')
        AND "District" <> 'State Total'
),
Pivot AS (
    SELECT
        "District",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN Literacy END) AS Literacy_NFHS4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN Literacy END) AS Literacy_NFHS5
    FROM
        LiteracyByRound
    GROUP BY
        "District"
)
SELECT
    "District"
FROM
    Pivot
WHERE
    Literacy_NFHS4 IS NOT NULL
    AND Literacy_NFHS5 IS NOT NULL
    AND Literacy_NFHS5 < Literacy_NFHS4
ORDER BY
    "District";
```
